title: Max building height 15m (Ground+3 habitable floors) in plots without stilt parking, clause (iv)

citations.original_text: Maximum height of the building shall be 15m (i.e. Ground+3 habitable floors) in plots without stilt parking. In plots with stilt parking height of the building shall be upto 17.5m (i.e. stilt + 4 habitable floors).

notes: 15m corresponds to Ground+3 habitable floors, without stilt parking.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 states this as Ground + 3 habitable floors (Other controls (iv), p.177).
